title: Tauranga Deals
meta_desc: Discover the best family deals in Tauranga and Mount Maunganui, including activity discounts, campervan hire, and travel insurance.
intro: Tauranga and Mount Maunganui are a haven for families, with plenty of activities, beautiful beaches, and a range of accommodation options. With the right deals and discounts, you can have a fantastic family holiday without breaking the bank. Here are the best family deals in Tauranga and Mount Maunganui for August 2026, with prices and tips to help you plan your trip.

sections.heading: Best-Value Activities
sections.body:
Some of the best-value activities in Tauranga and Mount Maunganui include swimming and surfing at Mount Beach, walking to the summit of Mount Maunganui, and visiting the hot pools at the Mount. These activities are not only fun but also relatively affordable, with prices ranging from free to $20 per person.

Surf lessons are also a great way to spend time as a family, with prices starting from around $50 per person for a group lesson. Papamoa Beach is another great spot for families, with its gentle surf and plenty of space to relax and play.
list: Walk to the summit of Mount Maunganui: free
Hot pools at the Mount: $10-$20 per person

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips
sections.body: To save money on your family holiday in Tauranga and Mount Maunganui, consider the following tips:
list: Book your accommodation and activities in advance to get the best prices
Look for package deals that include accommodation, activities, and travel insurance
Consider staying in a holiday park or motel instead of a hotel
Cook your own meals instead of eating out for every meal
Take advantage of free activities such as walking to the summit of Mount Maunganui and visiting Mount Beach
Use public transport or walk/bike instead of renting a car

sections.heading: When to Book for Best Prices
sections.body:
To get the best prices for your family holiday in Tauranga and Mount Maunganui, it's a good idea to book your accommodation and activities as early as possible. Many accommodation providers and activity operators offer early bird discounts or specials for bookings made well in advance.

Additionally, consider booking during the off-season (April to October) when prices are generally lower. However, keep in mind that some activities and attractions may be closed or have limited hours during this time.
